subject.title: feat(read): persist inbound media to workspace staging

question: Should cross-turn inbound-media persistence be a session-owned workspace artifact, and which component owns its lifecycle rather than the read-path resolver?
rationale: The PR introduces a new persistent workspace lifecycle for untrusted inbound media; choosing the canonical owner and retention boundary is a product and security contract, not a mechanical cleanup choice.

options.title: Use session-owned staging
options.body: Move persistence to the session/media staging owner, write through the root-scoped safe-write helper, and track only that session’s artifacts for disposal.

options.title: Keep inbound media ephemeral
options.body: Do not persist media into the workspace until a maintainer-approved cross-turn media contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Use session-owned staging
recommendation.body: Move persistence to the session/media staging owner, write through the root-scoped safe-write helper, and track only that session’s artifacts for disposal.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context does not identify a reliable current-main owner for the agents/session media lifecycle.
